title: Nanoplastics Alter DNA.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟研究功能化聚苯乙烯纳米塑料与DNA的直接结合及诱导B-DNA向A-DNA构象转变，属于广义蛋白质-DNA互作体系外的聚合物-DNA互作，方法为物理模拟，对TF-DNA互作建模有方法学参考价值。
abstract: Here we show that the direct binding of functionalized polystyrene chains can trigger biochemically relevant structural changes in DNA helices. For the stable association of the plastic and the biomolecule, the presence of the positively charged functional groups was found to be essential, which form strong Coulombic interactions with the phosphate moieties of the DNA, overcoming the interplay between the biomolecule and the aqueous medium. The geometric features of DNA showed a distinct shift from the initial B-DNA structure to the A-DNA form through the 100 ns simulations, implying that in the presence of the plastic the latter, rarer form becomes preferred. These conformational changes can have significant biochemical consequences and may be a part of the toxic effect of these materials.
abstract_zh: 在此我们展示，功能化聚苯乙烯链的直接结合能够触发DNA螺旋中具有生物化学意义的结构变化。对于塑料与生物分子的稳定结合，发现带正电荷的官能团的存在至关重要，这些官能团与DNA的磷酸基团形成强库仑相互作用，克服了生物分子与水介质之间的相互作用。通过100纳秒的模拟，DNA的几何特征显示出从初始B-DNA结构向A-DNA形式的明显转变，这表明在塑料存在下，后者这种较罕见的形式变得更为偏好。这些构象变化可能具有显著的生物化学后果，并可能是这些材料毒性效应的一部分。
